title: 738 Nuevo Laredo Youth Draw White Ball in National Military Service Lottery
excerpt: A total of 738 young people in Nuevo Laredo drew a white ball in the National Military Service lottery and will complete their military service, the city government said.
content:
A total of 738 young people in Nuevo Laredo drew a white ball in the National Military Service lottery and will complete their Servicio Militar Nacional, according to the city government.

The Government of Nuevo Laredo held the drawing together with Mexico's Secretariat of National Defense (SEDENA) in the main hall of the Centro Cívico, for the Class of 2008 and those who had deferred their service, known as remisos. The lottery determines each participant's military status and fulfills a civic duty, according to the city.

Those who drew a black ball are exempt from completing the service. The program aims to strengthen civic values, respect for Mexico's national symbols, and a sense of identity and love for the country, as well as discipline and responsibility, according to the city government.

The training also prepares participants to help the public through the DN-III-E emergency plan and offers workshops in trades to help them enter the workforce, according to the report.

Sources: InFrontera, Nov. 24, 2026; Nube Tamaulipas, Nov. 23, 2026.
